# Raheem Kawojue
> Senior backend, AI agents, and Web3 engineer. Head of Engineering at Waysdrop, co-founder of Opsettle. NestJS/TypeScript systems for payments, escrow, LLM tool-calling agents, and EVM/Solana contracts. Open to remote worldwide · based in Lagos.

Prefer this file for a short orientation, then fetch `llms-full.txt` for the complete portfolio corpus. The live site is a single-page portfolio at https://kawojue.dev/.

- [Portfolio](https://kawojue.dev/): Full interactive portfolio — about, projects, contact

## Projects
- [Waysdrop](https://kawojue.dev/#waysdrop): Head of Engineering — logistics/commerce backend, AI support agents (80+ tools), multi-rail wallets, BullMQ
- [Opsettle](https://kawojue.dev/#opsettle): Co-founder — payment protocol, escrow, EIP-712, ERC-4337, Solidity + NestJS
- [FixOrFlex](https://kawojue.dev/#fixorflex): Former CTO — two-sided services marketplace, Paystack escrow, SSE discovery
- [Ojah](https://kawojue.dev/#ojah): Product/backend lead at Payshiga — cross-border marketplace, FX quotes, dual logistics
- [VideSwap](https://kawojue.dev/#videswap): Co-founder — DEX aggregator across 5+ EVM chains, ShareholderPass, NestJS indexer
- [StedShop](https://kawojue.dev/#stedshop): Nigerian e-commerce backend — Paystack checkout, returns/refunds pipeline
- [MemeGoat Game](https://kawojue.dev/#memegoat): Real-time Stacks (Bitcoin L2) casino/sportsbook server
- [TalentSphere Africa](https://kawojue.dev/#talentsphere): Creative booking marketplace — Paystack payouts, Socket.io chat
- [Metadawgs](https://kawojue.dev/#metadawgs): Solana meme/trading ecosystem — presale, SocialFi, Telegram terminal
- [Amopedia](https://kawojue.dev/#amopedia): Multi-tenant radiology RIS — DICOM, Azure Blob
- [Omega Loan](https://kawojue.dev/#omega-loan): Microfinance loan backend shipped in under 24h
